high_level_description: The image is a promotional graphic for the upcoming Bollywood film "Dhoom 4." The background features a clear blue sky with a bright sun shining, creating a dramatic and vibrant atmosphere. In the foreground, there is a man with long hair and a beard, wearing sunglasses and a light-colored shirt. He appears to be leaning against a car, exuding an air of confidence and style. The text overlay on the image reads: "RANBIR KAPOOR collaborates WITH YASH RAJ FILMS FOR DHOOM 4" This indicates that Ranbir Kapoor will be starring in the fourth installment of the Dhoom franchise
